no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee meeting and other external consultations for this NDA review.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 210828 (Gallium Ga 68 edotreotide / Ga-68-DOTATOC). Section 9 of the FDA Multi-Disciplinary Review explicitly states there was no advisory committee meeting or other external consultations for this NDA review, so the committee had no influence on the approval. The review team found the benefit-risk favorable and recommended approval without AdComm input.
